next.reason: 1985: 'There must not be any entry that contains an OCCURS clause between the descriptions of the data items identified by the data-names'; 2023: 'If data-name-2 is subordinate to an alphanumeric group item... that group item shall not contain an OCCURS clause.'. 1985 bars any OCCURS entry placed between the subject and a KEY item, e.g. an earlier sibling table. 2023 bars OCCURS only in groups that contain data-name-2, so such a sibling is now allowed.
